data.exact_reserve_text: Included within the profit is an amount of GBP 33.6 million in respect of releases to reserves on 2013 and prior underwriting years (2014: GBP 26.8 million in respect of reserve releases from 2012 and prior underwriting years).

prior_year_events.impact_description: profit of GBP 34.7 million on business transacted in prior years inherited through the incoming reinsurance to close of the 2012 year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: For 2015, Syndicate 2007 reported a net release of GBP 33.6 million in reserves relating to the 2013 and prior underwriting years. This favorable development was primarily attributed to a comparatively benign natural catastrophe claims experience. Additionally, the syndicate recorded a profit of GBP 34.7 million from business inherited through the incoming reinsurance to close of the 2012 year of account.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within the profit is an amount of GBP 33.6 million in respect of releases to reserves on 2013 and prior underwriting years
comparatively benign natural catastrophe claims experience
a profit of GBP 34.7 million on business transacted in prior years inherited through the incoming reinsurance to close of the 2012 year of account.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -33.6m is a net figure (after reinsurance) as explicitly stated in the Chairman's Statement. No gross prior year development figure was available due to distortions in the gross claims development triangle caused by significant Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions. There is a contradiction between the Chairman's Statement (page 3) which states 'releases to reserves' and the Notes to the Financial Statements (page 18, Note 6) which states 'increases to reserves' for the same GBP 33.6 million amount. The Chairman's Statement's 'releases' aligns with the overall profit and 'benign natural catastrophe claims experience' mentioned in the report, so 'release' has been assumed.
